rca of the issue: Mobile close button issue reproduced at 390x844: click on [data-testid=close-menu] may resolve to an element outside viewport while sidebar is toggled, causing Playwright click failure. Mitigation: ensure close button remains within visible mobile sidebar bounds (layout/z-index/positioning) and keep backdrop close as fallback.
